name: Lookup Pharmacy
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Search the NLM NPI Registry for a single pharmacy by name and location hints. Returns individual fields if exactly one match is found, or a formatted list string if multiple matches are found.

inputs.name: pharmacy_name
inputs.label: Pharmacy Name
inputs.description: Name of the pharmacy to search for

inputs.name: alternative_names
inputs.label: Alternative Names
inputs.description: Comma-separated alternative names to search for (optional)

inputs.name: pharmacy_type
inputs.label: Pharmacy Type
inputs.description: 'retail' or 'digital' to filter by taxonomy code; leave blank to search all types

inputs.name: zip
inputs.label: Zip
inputs.description: Zip code of the pharmacy's location

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: State
inputs.description: State of the pharmacy's location (used when zip is not provided)

inputs.name: city
inputs.label: City
inputs.description: City of the pharmacy's location (used with state when zip is not provided)

inputs.name: streets
inputs.label: Streets
inputs.description: Street address hints to narrow results

inputs.name: street_number
inputs.label: Street Number
inputs.description: Street number to further narrow results when multiple candidates have the same street name

inputs.name: search_strategy
inputs.label: Search Strategy
inputs.description: 'radius' to expand search to nearest 100 zip codes, 'targeted' to use the exact location (city/state or zip) without expansion.

outputs.name: match_status
outputs.label: Match Status
outputs.description: Result of the lookup: 'Match' if exactly 1 candidate found, 'No Match' if 0 candidates found, or 'Ambiguous' if multiple candidates found

outputs.name: pharmacy_npi
outputs.label: NPI
outputs.description: NPI of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_name
outputs.label: Pharmacy Name
outputs.description: Name of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_street
outputs.label: Street
outputs.description: Street address of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_city
outputs.label: City
outputs.description: City of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_state
outputs.label: State
outputs.description: State of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_zipcode
outputs.label: Zipcode
outputs.description: Zipcode of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: pharmacy_phone
outputs.label: Phone
outputs.description: Phone number of the matched pharmacy if match_status is 'Match', otherwise null

outputs.name: failure_message
outputs.label: Failure Message
outputs.description: Human-readable explanation of why the match failed, ready for display

outputs.name: candidate_matches
outputs.label: Candidate Matches
outputs.description: JSON array of display strings when match_status is 'Ambiguous', formatted as 'Name — Street, City, State Zip'
